exposure: Combined intracervical Foley catheter and low-dose vaginal misoprostol
combined intracervical Foley catheter and low-dose vaginal misoprostol
cohort: 126 pregnant women at ≥ 28 gestational weeks with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation, intact membranes and a Bishop score of ≤ 4
finding: Adding a Foley catheter to misoprostol for labor induction did not significantly reduce the induction-to-delivery time but did reduce uterine hyperstimulation and meconium-stained liquor.
mod_finding: The addition of a Foley catheter to misoprostol for labor induction did not significantly reduce the induction-to-delivery time but did reduce uterine hyperstimulation and meconium-stained liquor.
